RESOLUTION:
1. To receive, consider and adopt the Financial Statements
for the financial year ended 30 June 2020 together with
the Chairman’s Statement, and the Directors’ and Auditors’
reports thereon.

2. To note that the Directors do not recommended the
payment of a dividend in respect of the financial year ended
30 June 2020.

3. To re-elect Mr Raymond Nyamweya Ondieki who retires at
this meeting in accordance with the provisions of Article 96
of the Company’s Articles of Association and, being eligible,
offers himself for re-election.
